entities.name: Alphonse-Louis du Plessis de Richelieu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alphonse-Louis du Plessis de Richelieu was a French Carthusian, bishop and Cardinal. He was the elder brother of Armand Cardinal Richelieu, the celebrated minister of Louis XIII.
